item: 9.11 — chip revert when the CLI rejects set_model (2026-08-30)
branch: __model_rejected frame (Kotlin -> webview, sent when the set_model control_response is an error) reverts the chip, the selection and the gauge to `previous` WITHOUT re-sending a model bridge, and draws the CLI's error text as an error block
provenance: The error text is the CLI's own, measured 2026-08-30 over stdio (CLI 2.1.251, panel flags) with a PreModelSwitch hook answering permissionDecision:deny: control_response {subtype:'error', error:'Model switch blocked by a PreModelSwitch hook: probe deny'}. The __model_rejected frame itself is OUR Kotlin->webview frame (self-consistency only). The roster is whatever the live panel holds; the fixture picks a target that differs from the current selection and restores the pre-fixture selection through the same revert path at the end (setModel is NOT called for the restore, so nothing is persisted or sent). The bridge is taped for the fixture's duration and restored in the last step. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-30 against the sandbox still serving the pre-change webview (started before the edit; build verified BY CONTENT: typeof showModel === 'undefined'): 6 passed, 6 failed — every DISCRIMINATING assert (selection/title not reverted, no error block, restore step) failed; the step-1 optimistic-switch asserts and the no-second-bridge assert are GUARDs that pass on both builds. The 'null previous -> roster head' assert passed vacuously in the control (the target happened to be the roster head) — it discriminates only together with the restore assert. First fixed-build run: 9/3, the three failures were the fixture's own selector slip (.blk for what errorBlock emits, .error) — corrected, then 12/12. LIVE END-TO-END 2026-08-30: a real PreModelSwitch deny hook in the testing repo's settings.local.json (removed afterwards), setModel('haiku') through the REAL bridge: hook input to_model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 source:sdk, chip back to `default`, one .error block 'Model switch blocked by a PreModelSwitch hook: probe deny'; the persisted `sonnet` was refused on the restart re-apply too (previous:null path) and the chip came up on the roster head.
